content.title: Film Recommendations
content.body:
A collection of personally recommended films with brief descriptions of their appealing qualities.

## Everything Everywhere All at Once
Offers mind-bending multiverse exploration while delivering surprising emotional depth and family narrative.

**Tags**: #multiverse #science-fiction #family-drama

## Parasite
Directed by Bong Joon-ho, masterfully shifts between genres while delivering sharp social commentary on class inequality.

**Tags**: #Korean-cinema #social-commentary #thriller

## Arrival
A thoughtful science fiction film that focuses on language and communication rather than conventional alien invasion tropes, offering a more cerebral approach to first contact.

**Tags**: #science-fiction #linguistics #first-contact
